---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

Describe the problem or limitation this feature would solve.

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this to work? Describe the desired behavior or API.

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered other approaches? List them.

## Use Case

Describe how you or others would use this feature. Why is it important?

## Additional Context

- Screenshots, mockups, or examples if applicable
- Links to related issues or discussions
- Any other relevant information

## Implementation Notes (Optional)

If you have ideas about how to implement this:

- Affected modules (analyzer, fixer, UI, etc.)
- Approximate complexity estimate
- Potential safety/performance concerns
